developer: Bangladesh Agriculture Research Institute(BARI), Gazipur, Bangladesh
planting_time: Rabi: Mid November to mid December
harvest_time: Ripening time require in rabi season 125-130 days and 90-100 days in karif season
yield_t_ha: Yeld in rabi season 3.5-4 t/ha and 2.5-3.5 t/ha in karif season
main_characteristics: It is a composite variety of popcorn.  There is a presence of deep anthocyanin and 1 st leaf sheath and medium pigmentation in leaf sheath at 2-leaf stage.Plant height is medium (165-180cm) and ear height 70-80cm. Kernels are small size, 1000 grain weight 140-150 g, kernels are yellow flint type.  Upper portion of leaf is smaller than lower portion,  high poping quality (95%). Intermediate maturing.
source_org: BARI, via BSMRAU Digital Herbarium of Crop Plants
